name: Orbit
url: https://orbit.kiwi (DNS did not resolve on 2026-10-08); source https://github.com/kiwicom/orbit (docs in docs/src/documentation)
bestFor: booking, checkout and multi-step transactional flows (Wizard, Stepper, Itinerary, Seat, Coupon, ChoiceGroup components)
white-label / partner products where one foundation object regenerates the whole theme
mobile-first consumer web with large touch targets (44px default form box)
products needing a disciplined status palette with Light/Dark pairing rules
avoidFor: dense analytics or admin UI (default control 44px, no compact mode)
dark-mode-first products (no dark theme in the token package)
expressive brand marketing (deliberately plain, Roboto by default)
teams needing an actively maintained public doc site (orbit.kiwi unreachable; Compose library archived July 2025)

families: base (open-source default): 'Roboto', -apple-system, '.SFNSText-Regular', 'San Francisco', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Lucida Grande', sans-serif
Kiwi.com production: 'Circular Pro' (Lineto, licensed for kiwi.com domain only) swapped in via getTokens({base:{fontFamily}})
typography.notes: Body default is 15px, an unusual odd size. Weights 400/500/700. Docs: build hierarchy with size first, use weight and colour only to emphasise; ink-dark is the ONLY heading colour; don't combine Display and Title 1 on one page (gap to body too large); use Display Subtitle for a short description under a display title; lineHeightText token 1.4 for paragraphs.

semantic.every hue: light, lightHover, lightActive, normal, normalHover, normalActive, dark, darkHover, darkActive, darker
semantic.interactive vs actionable: interactive (hover/focus/select/drag states that don't advance the flow) uses blue; actionable (Button, ButtonLink, TextLink that move you forward) uses product teal

color.darkMode: None in @kiwicom/orbit-design-tokens 11.0.0 (single light foundation). Theming is white-label via getTokens(foundation), not light/dark.
color.contrastNotes: Docs: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 for text over 24px (18px bold) and for UI graphics; touch targets at least 44x44 CSS px; avoid pure black on pure white (dyslexia). Docs openly admit 'slight contrast issues in the product color': measured product-normal #008F7B vs white 4.03:1 (fails AA for normal text); product-dark #007061 vs white 6.02:1, ink-normal #4F5E71 6.62:1, ink-dark #252A31 14.44:1, orange-normal #B36200 4.50:1 (exactly AA).

spacing.notes: Tokens space50..space1600. Docs table: 4 (connect error to field), 8 (header to description), 12, 16 (mobile inner padding), 24 (section side padding), 32, 40, 52 (illustration to header). 'Please use only these sizes.'

radius.rule: Buttons small/normal rounded-200 (8px), large rounded-300 (12px); badge 12px; modal 16px. Older docs page still states 3px desktop / 6px mobile ('smaller on desktop because tightly grouped fields look disconnected with larger radii') - superseded by the token scale but the reasoning stands.

shadows: level1 (actionable, e.g. Tile): 0 2px 6px ink-normal@8%, 0 0 2px ink-normal@12%, 0 0 1px base@30%
level3 (Popover, Tooltip, Drawer): 0 2px 16px ink@4%, 0 34px 20px ink@5%, 0 15px 15px ink@10% (+ reverse variant with negative y for bottom-stuck mobile popovers)
depth.borders: Flat level = 1px cloud-normal #E8EDF1 border, no shadow, for non-actionable Cards. Suppressed level = cloud-light #F5F7F9 background, no shadow.

motion.notes: durationFast 0.15s, durationNormal 0.3s, durationSlow 0.4s. No published motion guidance found in fetched docs.

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Strong for colour: every hue has hover and active for light, normal and dark shades; button tokens (91) cover each type x state. Disabled and focus states not separately tokenised in the token package (handled in components).

tokenArchitecture: Foundation -> createTokens -> component tokens. A small typed 'foundation' object (palette of 10 hues x 10 shade/state keys, borderRadius, breakpoint, elevations, size, space, fontFamily/Size/Weight, lineHeight) is passed to getTokens(), which derives ~456 flat camelCase tokens grouped by component (button*, form*, heading*, badge*, alert*, elevation*, tab*, zIndex*). Shadows are built by a boxShadow() helper from foundation colours with transparentColor(). Since v27 components are styled with a Tailwind 3 preset generated from the same tokens (h-form-box-normal, rounded-200, px-button-padding-md).
distinctiveness: Travel-domain vocabulary baked into components (Itinerary, Seat, StopoverArrow, CarrierLogo, Coupon), the teal 'product' colour with an explicit interactive-blue vs actionable-teal split, a Light/Normal/Dark + Hover/Active shade grammar shared by every hue, and seven named elevation levels including 'suppressed' and 'flat' (below shadow).
weaknesses: Public docs site orbit.kiwi did not resolve (2026-10-08); docs only in the GitHub repo; Android Compose library archived 2025
Primary product colour #008F7B fails AA for small text on white (4.03:1), acknowledged in docs
No dark mode and no compact density
Production typeface (Circular Pro) is licence-restricted; open-source default is Roboto
Legacy radius doc (3px/6px) contradicts current tokens
takeaways: Expose a tiny 'foundation' object and derive every component token from it with a function; white-labelling becomes one object swap
Split 'interactive' colour (state feedback that does not advance the flow) from 'actionable' colour (moves the user forward) so the brand colour always means 'next step'
Pair rule: Dark shade text on Light shade background of the same hue is always safe; never use a Dark shade as a background
Elevation is semantic of actionability: non-clickable cards are flat (1px border), clickable tiles get Level 1, hover lifts to Level 2
Give icon-side button padding one step less than the text side (ps-button-padding-sm pe-button-padding-md) for optical balance
Reverse shadows (negative y) for bottom-anchored mobile popovers and fixed footers
provenance: public-spec (npm @kiwicom/orbit-design-tokens@11.0.0 dist, @kiwicom/orbit-components@27.7.1-alpha.0, docs mdx on GitHub master); contrast ratios measured by computation
